issue.description:
ADR-005's recorded drawback: there is no way to mark an assignment as a deliberate reservation, so a legitimately parked issue warns on every doctor run and trains operators to ignore the ready_frontier check. Design an explicit held/parked marker settable through a public CLI mutation (atomic, audited, attribution via --actor, checkpoint round-trip and unknown-field safe), suppress the ADR-005 ready_frontier warning for marked issues, and test that marked issues remain excluded from the claim frontier and that the marker survives restore.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Allow an assignment to be marked as intentionally held so doctor warnings stay meaningful
